need to be worn with a suit

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. A man on a bike had to ride on the pavement.

B. When he tried to plunge onto the road, a car hit him.

C. As the bus inched through the evening life, the traffic grew.

D. There was no space on the road anymore.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** CDAB**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The first should be **C** as it describes the start of an incident i.e. the bus inching through the evening life.
 
• Then it should be **D** as it states how after the traffic grew, there was no space on the road. Then we talk about a man riding on the pavement i.e **A**. Last, it should be** B.**

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Ananya plucks fresh flowers from the garden every day.

options.text: Fresh flowers are plucked by Ananya from the garden every day.
Fresh flowers have been plucked by Ananya From the garden every day.
Fresh garden is plucked by Ananya form the flowers every day.
Fresh flowers were plucked by Ananya from the garden every day.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 1.**

The given sentence has **Ananya as subject **and** fresh flowers as an object.** So change in voice will reverse this. Also, the sentence is in the present tense. So, option 1 is correct.

**Option 2** is in present participle tense.

**Option 3** is incorrect.

**Option 4** is in the past tense.

questions.question:

questions.question:

**Respect **means a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements.

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences, Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. Once the formalities are done, you can start using your account and save time and money.

B. Opening a bank account can seem intimidating.

C. Getting your account opened is just a matter of providing certain details and funding your account.

D. Fortunately, most banks follow a standardized process.
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

First should be** B **as it gives an introduction of what is being talked about i.e how opening a bank account is intimidating. Next should be** D** as it is the statement contradicting B and describes how banks follow a standardized process. After D, it should be **C** as it shows how the account can be opened and C should be followed by **A.**

**The sequence is :BDCA.**

questions.question:

questions.solution:

**Entering **is in present continuous tense but the phrase **had started** is in past participle tense. So, option 3 contains an error. It should be --**When I entered.**

questions.question:

options.text: Dinesh's grandmother looks after him when his parents wen abroad.
Dinesh's grandmother looked after him when his parents went abroad.
Dinesh looked after his grandmother when his parents went abroad.
Dines's grandmother was looking after him when his parents went abroad.

questions.solution:
